stages.reference: Create a close reference for moderately weakened frosted ice midway through a progressive four-stage breakage. Preserve the same cool, subtly translucent material, trapped air, pale frost and calm blue-gray value range as its earlier forms, now with several spreading pressure cracks and cloudy knots at selected intersections. The stress network should feel irregular and mechanically plausible, with sizable intact ice between branches. Reveal the fracture planes through gentle internal haze rather than drawn white outlines. Weather has dulled the surface but not made it opaque. Avoid perfect spiderweb geometry, bright slashes, black abyss-like seams, separated shards or freshly fallen snow. The image should communicate an increase in damage without losing material-family continuity or becoming an illustration of shattered glass.
